previous_assumption: Workspace packages like @fleetip/contracts can ship TypeScript source with no build step, since tsx/Next/Vitest all transpile on the fly.
correction: That breaks for the actual production `node dist/index.js` path — plain Node can't resolve TS source at all. apps/api's build needed an esbuild bundling step (build.mjs) that inlines internal workspace packages while keeping real npm dependencies external.
